business_summary.text: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited manufactures sugar, ethanol, and power with integrated operations in Uttar Pradesh.

call_points.text: Management expects continued improvement in profitability driven by higher ethanol blending and better sugar realisations
Average cost of long-term borrowings reduced to 7.98% in Q1FY27 from previous levels

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 10 Per Share

guidance.statement: Continued improvement in profitability driven by higher ethanol blending and better sugar realisations

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Agricultural Food & other Products > Sugar

operating_notes.text: Sugar sales volume increased by 10% YoQ to 36.70 lac qtls in Q1FY27
Ethanol production stood at 22.1 lac litres in Q1FY27, primarily from B-molasses
Power production was 21.30 lac units in Q1FY27, with 17.30 lac units sold to the grid

timeline.summary: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited reported Q1FY27 results with a turnaround to profitability, driven by improved sugar realisations and higher sales volume.
